events.evidence: She reveals that it is one of the 21 O Wazamono grade swords and is worth no less than 1,000,000
events.description: Tashigi reveals that Zoro's sword Wado Ichimonji is a valuable O Wazamono grade blade.

events.evidence: The woman vows to retrieve all the high-grade swords that are being used for evil.
events.description: Tashigi vows to take back every high-grade sword that criminals use for evil.

events.evidence: Zoro is given the Sandai Kitetsu and Yubashiri for free and now owns three swords again.
events.description: Ipponmatsu gives Zoro the cursed Sandai Kitetsu and his heirloom Yubashiri for free after Zoro survives the curse.

events.evidence: Unbeknownst to Zoro, the woman is actually a Marine named Tashigi
events.description: The swordswoman Zoro met is revealed to be Tashigi, a Marine.
